text:
jessica_support: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 502/504 spikes since the 09:10 deploy of `kernel-selector-v2`. Support tickets from two larger customers (payments and search) show timeouts and retries. screenshots attached.

arjun_oncall: oncall here, seeing gateway 502 rising from 0.2% -> ~6% in last 15m. Most errors are `upstream reset` and `timeout`. Rolling back? :eyes:

maria_sre: can we confirm which subset of traffic got kernel-selector-v2? rollout was staged 10% -> 30% -> 100% overnight. Any mis-routed slices?

daniel_eng: I pushed kernel-selector-v2 — it changes kernel path selection for long-context models to `kernel_v2_fast`. Hypothesis: selector returning unsupported kernel for some model variants causing segfaults in runtime, leading to 5xx. Logs: ``ERROR runtime: kernel not found for model=redwood-tiny variant=fp16_kv``

deploy-bot: Deploy report: `kernel-selector-v2` promoted at 2026-07-03T09:10Z. Route weights: region-eu:50%, region-us:50%. Canary windows: 30%. No automatic rollback triggered.

jessica_support: Customer billing notes: retries causing higher token usage for affected customers, one billing complaint already. Need communication plan.

arjun_oncall: Maria — can you cut traffic to v2 to 0% on the router? I can trigger rollback if we confirm state.

maria_sre: Doing traffic cut now -> setting route weight v2:0% across both regions. Will monitor.

[system] Maria changed route weights: v2=0% -> v1=100%

oliver_pm: Heads-up: prod metrics show 5xx dropping back to baseline after traffic cut. We should coordinate a controlled rollback and postmortem.

daniel_eng: repro steps for local test: 1) run `make runtime-test` with MODEL=redwood-tiny VARIANT=fp16_kv; 2) curl local endpoint with long prompt > 2048 tokens; 3) observe crash stack: ``segfault at 0x7ff... kernel_lookup()``. Attaching minimal repro script.

linh_prodsec: Any chance this also affects auth headers or request size sanitizers? Need to confirm no credentials leaked in retries.

daniel_eng: No, auth path unaffected. Failures are deterministic on kernel lookup. Workaround: fallback to kernel_v1 when selector fails; patch incoming.

maria_sre: Rolling back the staged config and rebalancing now. Metrics: gateway 502 rate dropped from 6.1% -> 0.4% in 4m.

jessica_support: Sending triage email to affected customers with apology + explanation that we rolled the selector back to stable. Will include monitoring link and ticket refs.

arjun_oncall: Next steps: 1) hotfix fallback in runtime (daniel), 2) add selector unit tests for variant coverage (daniel), 3) add alert for kernel lookup errors (maria), 4) postmortem & customer note (oliver + jessica).

oliver_pm: I'm scheduling a postmortem meeting. Please drop notes in the incident doc with timelines and impact estimates.

daniel_eng: patch PR opened: `runtime: add kernel selector fallback` -> ready for quick review.

maria_sre: leaving monitoring for 30m; if stable, clear paging and update incident channel.

jessica_support: Thanks all — will update customers once we confirm stability.
